comparisons.hypothesis: Separation 8 beats 4: the metrics preferred 4 for crossings, but overlaps matter more to the eye
Outward 0.4 beats 1.5: the default already streams the graph in one direction
Pull to spacing 3 beats 6: a weaker pull bunches children less and still keeps the graph compact
With the strength floor, even spread 5 keeps its roundness without the long weak connections
All of the above together beat the defaults
Control: practically the same settings (pull to spacing 6 vs 6.2); expect "same" or random picks
Spacing 3.5 beats 4: denser is nicer (3.1 beat 6.8)
Even spread 2.5 beats 1: rounder, and weak connections do not fly out yet (they did at 5.6)
A strength floor of 0.3 for the length pull keeps weak connections shorter without bunching
